Raising Cane’s at Home 🐔🏠 For ALL of you asking - the app link for Osta is in my bio or you can search “Osta Recipes” on the App Store or Google Play store ‼️🫶 Crispy buttermilk chicken tenders, addictive Cane’s sauce and fluffy texas toast… all at home!  For the Chicken: -2 lbs (0.9 kg) chicken breast, sliced into strips (or use tenderloins) -2 cups buttermilk -1/3 cup pickle juice -Seasonings: 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp black pepper -Neutral oil, for frying Flour Mixture: -2 cups all-purpose flour +1/2 cup cornstarch -1 tsp baking powder -Seasonings: 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp paprika, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper Cane’s Sauce -1/2 cup mayonnaise -1/4 cup ketchup -2 tsp Worcestershire sauce -Seasonings: 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp black pepper, 1 tsp seasoning salt Instructions: 1. Slice the chicken breasts into strips about 1 inch thick and 3–4 inches long (roughly tender-sized). In a bowl, whisk together the buttermilk, pickle juice, and chicken seasonings until fully combined. Add the chicken and toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or overnight for extra tender chicken. 2. In a large bowl, combine the flour, cornstarch, baking powder, and flour mixture seasonings. Mix. 3. Add neutral oil to a large pot or deep skillet until it is about 2–3 inches deep. Heat the oil to 350°F / 175°C.  Keeping the oil around this temperature ensures crispy chicken without burning the coating. 4. Drizzle a little buttermilk marinade into the flour mixture and stir to create flaky, crispy bits. Shake excess marinade off the chicken, then coat each piece thoroughly in the flour mixture. Shake off any extra flour and gently place into the hot oil. 5. Don’t touch them for the first 1–2 mins, that’s how you get the perfect crust. Fry for 7–10 mins, or until golden brown and cooked through. Transfer the chicken to a paper towel-lined rack to drain. 6. In a bowl, combine all the sauce ingredients then refrigerate.  7. Serve the chicken with a side of sauce, texas toast & crinkle fries… Enjoy :) #dinner #raisingcanes #chicken #tiktokrecipe #recipesoftiktok #dinneridea #homecooking

Strawberry Nutella Brownies 🍓🤎 Perfect brownies for summer!  (recipe makes an 8x8 pan) Ingredients:  10 tbsp (140g) unsalted butter, melted 1 cup (200g) granulated sugar ¼ cup (50g) brown sugar, packed  2 eggs, room temp 1 tsp vanilla extract ½ cup + 2 tbsp (56g) unsweetened cocoa powder ½ tsp salt 1 tbsp (13g) vegetable oil ½ cup (63g) all purpose flour, spooned & leveled or weighed (don’t pack it in) ¾ cup chocolate chips 190g (~⅔ cup) Nutella  Topping: Strawberry slices, patted dry (as many as you want/enough to cover the top) Nutella (to spread over the top & drizzle)  Instructions: Line an 8x8 pan with parchment paper. Spread the nutella onto the parchment into a thin, even square the size of the pan. Freeze for at least 30 minutes or until frozen solid. Preheat oven to 325°F and line/grease an 8x8 pan with parchment. In a large bowl, whisk melted butter, granulated sugar, and brown sugar until smooth. Add eggs and vanilla, then whisk vigorously for 1-2 minutes. Stir in cocoa powder and salt until fully combined. Mix in oil, then gently fold in the flour until just combined (don’t over mix). Fold in chocolate chips. Spread half the batter into the greased pan. Place the frozen nutella sheet on top of it. Then, spread the remaining batter over it to cover the nutella layer completely. Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until a toothpick near the center comes out with no wet batter. It should just come out with a little nutella & slightly moist crumbs. Let the brownies cool completely. Spread a thin layer of nutella over the cooled brownies, add strawberry slices (patted dry) all over the top, and drizzle with more nutella.  Best enjoyed fresh!  #bakingrecipe #brownies #chocolatestrawberries #nutella #recipe

Cowboy butter steak bites ✨ My husband ate both of these plates and rated it a 10/10 😭 Ingredients  Steak - 2 pounds ribeye or sirloin steak, cubed - 1 tbsp neutral oil - 2 tsp Worcestershire sauce  - 2 tsp garlic powder  - Salt and pepper to taste (generous amount) “Caramelized” onions  - 1 large yellow onion, sliced - 1 tsp granulated sugar  - Heaping pinch of salt Cowboy butter - 12 tbsp unsalted butter - 5 garlic cloves, minced  - 1 shallot, minced  - 1 lemon, freshly squeezed - 1 tbsp Dijon mustard  - 1 heaping tbsp parsley, chopped - 1 heaping tbsp chives, chopped - 1 tsp thyme - 1 tsp cayenne powder (adjust to heat preference  - 1/2 tsp red chili flakes - 1/2 tsp smoked paprika  - Salt to taste  Instructions  - Toss cubed steak with oil, Worcestershire, garlic powder, and a generous amount of salt & pepper. Set aside while the pan heats. - Heat a skillet over medium heat with a little oil or butter. - Add onions, sugar, and salt. Cook 15-20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until soft, golden, and jammy. Remove from pan and set aside. - Crank heat to medium-high/high. Add steak in a single layer (work in batches if needed). - Sear 2–3 minutes per side until deeply browned. Remove and set aside. Lower heat to medium. - Add butter to the same pan. Once melted, add garlic and shallot — cook ~30 seconds until fragrant. - Stir in lemon juice, Dijon, parsley, chives, thyme, cayenne, chili flakes, smoked paprika, and salt. - Add steak back to the pan. - Toss to coat in the butter sauce for 1–2 minutes. - Serve over creamy mashed potatoes and enjoy! • • • #recipe #steak #dinnerideas #food #steak

Hot Honey Chicken Pasta 🍯🔥 the viral recipe with over 60+ million views, 20/10 hits every time! Recipe: Chicken Tenders • 1 lb chicken tenderloins • 1 tsp onion powder • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp seasoned salt • 1 tsp creole seasoning • 1 tsp cayenne pepper (optional, adjust to spice) • 1 tsp all purpose seasoning • 1 sazon packet • 1–2 cups buttermilk • ⅛ cup jalapeño or pickle juice • 3 cups all-purpose flour (season with same seasonings) Hot Honey Sauce • ½ cup buffalo sauce • ¼ cup honey • ⅛ cup hot sauce (optional) Pasta • 1 lb penne pasta • 2 tbsp unsalted butter • 2 garlic cloves, finely minced • ½ yellow onion, finely chopped • 1 ½ cups heavy cream • 1 tsp onion powder • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp seasoned salt • 1 tsp creole seasoning • 1 tsp cayenne pepper (optional) • 1 tsp all purpose seasoning • 1 tsp black pepper • Grated mozzarella • Grated Parmesan Instructions 1. Season chicken tenderloins add in buttermilk and jalapeño/pickle juice then marinate for at least 30 minutes to an hour.  2. Coat chicken in seasoned flour set aside on wire rack and rest for 10 minutes before frying. Fry at 350°F until golden brown and crispy. Set aside and let cool on a wire rack. 3. In a sauce pan, add 1 tbsp of unsalted butter, buffalo sauce, honey, and hot sauce and simmer until fully combined. Then toss chicken in the hot honey sauce. 4. In a skillet, melt butter and sauté garlic and onion until fragrant. Pour in heavy cream and stir in all seasonings. 5. Add mozzarella and Parmesan until melted and creamy, then toss in cooked pasta. 6. Top creamy pasta with hot honey chicken and extra sauce if desired and enjoy :) #hothoneychickenpasta #hothoney #chickenpasta #pasta #fypシ

Creamy Tuscan Chicken 🍗✨ This creamy Tuscan chicken is packed with juicy seasoned chicken, garlic, spinach, and sweet grape tomatoes in a rich Parmesan cream sauce. It’s perfect served over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice! 😋  🍗 Creamy Tuscan Chicken Ingredients:  Chicken seasoning  * 2 to 3 chicken breasts, sliced in half * Salt & pepper * ½ tsp smoked paprika * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tbsp Italian seasoning * 1 tsp dried parsley * ½ tsp chili flakes (optional) Sauce: * 1 tbsp butter * ½ onion, diced * 3 garlic cloves, minced * 1 cup grape tomatoes, halved * 2 cups spinach * 1 cup heavy cream * ¼ cup grated Parmesan * Salt & pepper, to taste * Fresh parsley Directions: Season the chicken with all the spices. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a skillet and cook the chicken for 4–5 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Remove and set aside. In the same skillet, melt the butter and sauté the onion and garlic until fragrant. Add the tomatoes and cook for 2–3 minutes, then stir in the spinach until wilted. Pour in the heavy cream and Parmesan, stirring until smooth and creamy. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Return the chicken to the skillet and let simmer for 2–3 minutes. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice. Enjoy! 🤍

Butter Chicken Recipe 🍛🔥👇🏼  For chicken:   2 chicken breast   3 tbsp Greek yogurt   Minced ginger   1 tsp garlic powder, paprika, cayenne, salt, cumin   1/2 lemon   For sauce:   1 tbsp butter   1/2 onion   2 fresh cloves garlic   1/2 tsp paprika, cumin, salt and chicken bouillon powder (optional)   2 1/4 cup tomato passata   1-2 tsp sugar   1 cup heavy cream   2 tbsp butter   cilantro   First, we’re going to cut the chicken into small cubes and season it with the spices, fresh ginger, lemon, and Greek yogurt. Then in a pan, add oil and fry the chicken.   Meanwhile, finely chop the onion and garlic.   Once the chicken is ready, remove it from the pan. In the same pan, add a small piece of butter and fry the onion, garlic, and spices together for 5 minutes over low heat until softened. Then add the tomato passata, sugar, and heavy cream. Mix very well and cook for a couple of minutes, then add two small pieces of butter to make it extra creamy. Finally, add the fried chicken back in, mix everything together, and top with cilantro and a little heavy cream. Serve it with white rice and naan bread.   👀 Remember that seasonings are always to taste, so don’t be afraid to add more if needed. If it tastes too acidic from the tomato sauce, don’t forget to add sugar to balance the flavors. #butterchicken #easyrecipe #foodie

Activate the yeast In a small bowl, whisk together warm milk, sugar and yeast, 2. Add in melted butter, and egg. stir in flour and salt gradually until a soft dough forms. Knead for 5–6 minutes (by hand or mixer) until smooth and slightly tacky but not sticky. 3. Let it rise Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover with a towel or plastic wrap, and let rise in a warm spot for 1 to 1½ hours, until doubled in size. 4. Roll and cut Punch down the dough and roll it out on a lightly floured surface to about ¼ inch (0.6 cm) thick. Cut into 2½-inch (6 cm) squares using a sharp knife or pizza cutter. 5. Fry Heat oil in a deep pot to 350°F (175°C). Fry beignets 3–4 at a time for 1–2 minutes per side, until golden brown and puffed. Remove and drain on paper towels. 6. Dust & serve Generously dust with powdered sugar while still warm — don’t be shy, it’s part of the charm! School Nights in the Slow Cooker  Part 4 | Crockpot Broccoli Cheddar Chicken Orzo  This is one of those easy dinners that feels like comfort food but is simple enough for a busy school night! Ingredients 1–1½ lbs chicken breast ½ sweet onion, diced ½ cup shredded carrots Chicka Licka Bam Bam Chicken Rub, to taste @Fire & Smoke Society  ½ tsp garlic powder ½ tsp onion powder 2 tsp chicken bouillon powder ½ tsp paprika ¼ tsp black pepper 1½ cups chicken broth 2 cups broccoli 1 cup orzo 1 (8 oz) block cheddar cheese, freshly shredded plus more for topping  ½ cup heavy cream Salt, to taste at the end Directions 1. Add the chicken, diced onion, shredded carrots, chicken rub, garlic powder, onion powder, chicken bouillon powder, paprika, black pepper, and chicken broth to your slow cooker. 2. Cover and cook on LOW for 4–5 hours or HIGH for 2–3 hours, until the chicken is cooked through and tender. 3. Remove the chicken, shred or chop it, and return it to the slow cooker. 4. Stir in the orzo, broccoli, heavy cream, and shredded cheddar. Cover and cook on HIGH for about 30 minutes, stirring once or twice, until the orzo is tender. Keep an eye on it toward the end since orzo can absorb liquid quickly. 5. Taste before adding any salt. The chicken bouillon and chicken rub already contain salt, so you may not need much! #easyrecipe #crockpot #slowcooker #dinnerideas #easydinner

Strawberry Pull-Apart Bread 🍓✨ Dough: 3 cups all-purpose flour (360g) 5 tbsp melted butter (71g) 3 tbsp granulated sugar (38g) 1 tsp salt (6g) 2¼ tsp active dry yeast (7g) 1 large egg (50g) ¾ cup warm milk (180g) 1 tsp vanilla extract Simple Glaze: 1 cup powdered sugar (120g) 1–2 tbsp milk (15–30g) 1 tbsp melted butter (14g) Splash of vanilla extract Strawberry Compote Ingredients:  300g strawberries (about 2 cups, chopped) 75–90g granulated sugar (6–7 tbsp) 1 tbsp lemon juice 10–12g cornstarch (1–1½ tbsp) 30g water (2 tbsp) Instructions: In a bowl, mix warm milk, sugar, and yeast and let sit for 8–10 minutes until foamy, then add the egg, melted butter, and vanilla and mix until combined; add in the flour and salt and knead for about 8–10 minutes until smooth, then cover and let rise for 1 hour or until doubled. Meanwhile, make the strawberry compote by cooking strawberries, sugar, and lemon juice over medium heat until soft and juicy (about 5–7 minutes), lightly mash, then stir in the cornstarch mixed with water and cook until thickened, then let cool completely. Roll the dough into a rectangle, spread the strawberry compote evenly over the surface, cut into strips, stack them, and slice into pieces, then place upright into a greased loaf pan, cover and let rise for another 30 minutes before baking at 350°F (175°C) for 35–45 minutes until golden, then mix the glaze ingredients and drizzle over the warm bread. #breadmaking #strawberry #pullapartbread #baking #recipes

Full recipe below ⬇️  Ingredients:  -3 chicken breast  -1 chopped onion  -1 tbsp butter -4 chopped garlic cloves  -1 tsp salt  -1/2 tsp pepper  -1 tsp dried parsley  -2 chicken stock pots  -2 heaped tbsp flour  -350ml milk  -frozen mixed veg -100ml water  -1 roll puff pastry  -1 egg for egg wash  -sprinkle of rosemary  Method:  -place your chopped onion and garlic into a pan on medium heat with a splash of oil and a tbsp of butter to soften up  -add in your chicken diced up to bite size pieces and your 2 stick cubes and stir every few minutes until chicken is fully cooked -once your chicken is cooked through, add in your flour and cook for 5 minutes, then your milk, keep stirring this around until it thickens up nicely  -once thick, add in your frozen veg and your water, mix well and leave to cook for another 5 minutes or so until it’s at the consistency you like, then set to one side to cool -roll out your puff pastry sheet and cut into small squares and place them along the top of your pie mix so it’s all covered then cover with egg wash  -place on the oven for 25-30 minutes on 200 degrees Celsius or until golden and crispy on top (if you don’t have a oven safe pan, place your mix into a oven dish and do the same process)  -once done, sprinkle with a little salt and rosemary and enjoy! 🤍✨ИДЕАЛЬНЫЙ КЛАССИЧЕСКИЙ ЧИЗКЕЙК Ингредиенты на форму 18-20 см: • песочное печенье - 350 г • сливочное масло - 130 г • творожный сыр - 400 г • сахарная пудра - 120 г • яйца С1 - 2 шт. • сливки 33% - 150  • лимонный сок - 1 ст. л. Процесс приготовления: 1. Для основы измельчаем печенье в крошку с помощью блендера, смешиваем с растопленным сливочным масло и формируем основу с бортиками (удобнее всего с помощью стакана) 2. Для начинки все ингредиенты берем комнатной температуры! Творожный сыр смешиваем с сахарной пудрой с помощью лопатки. По одному вводим яйца и после каждого тщательно перемешиваем венчиком. Добавляем сливки, лимонный сок и ещё раз хорошенько перемешиваем 3. Выливаем начинку на основу и отправляем чизкейк в разогретую до 130 градусов духовку на 1.5 часа (режим верх-низ). На дно духовки можно поставить емкость с горячей водой, чтобы поверхность чизкейка получилась гладкой без трещинок 4. Готовый чизкейк обязательно полностью остужаем, в идеале 2-3 часа при комнатной температуре, а затем ночь в холодильнике. Украшаем по вкусу и наш десерт готов! #чизкейк #чизкейкрецепт #чизкейкньюйорк #десерт #рекомендации

BUN BO HUE aka my favorite food EVER 🥢 #bunbohue #vietnamesefood #noodles #easyrecipe #asmr  Bun Bo Hue Broth - Flank steak - Parboiled beef bones - Lemongrass - Pineapple - Ginger - Daikon - Shallot - Yellow onion - Water - Salt - Chicken bouillon - Mushroom bouillon - Fish sauce - Shrimp paste - Saté Parboil the flank steak and beef bones for 5–10 minutes, then rinse well. Add to a large stock pot with slightly smashed lemongrass, pineapple, ginger, daikon, shallot, onion, and a few spoonfuls of salt. Cover with water, bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer and cook for 1 hour, continuously skimming the scum from the top. Remove the flank steak and set aside to cool, then add the saté and simmer the broth for another 5 hours. Remove the onion, shallot, and ginger (I keep the daikon for my bowls) and season with chicken bouillon, mushroom bouillon, fish sauce, and shrimp paste. Taste and adjust to your preference. Saté - Shallot - Garlic - Lemongrass - Avocado oil - BBH seasoning - Red pepper flakes - Sugar - Shrimp paste - Fish sauce Sauté finely minced shallot, garlic, and lemongrass in avocado oil for about 5 minutes, until slightly golden and fragrant. Add a packet of BBH seasoning and red pepper flakes and sauté for another 2 minutes. Add half to the broth and reserve the other half for garnish. To the reserved saté, add a small ladle of broth, sugar, shrimp paste, and fish sauce, then sauté for another couple minutes. Bowl - Thick rice vermicelli - Cabbage - Bean sprouts - Sliced flank steak - Yellow onion - Green onion - Cilantro - Lime - Saté I like to prep all my toppings ahead of time and store them in glass containers for easy assembly throughout the week. Rinse and dry the cabbage and bean sprouts well, then store in a paper towel-lined container. Keep the sliced flank steak separate. For the noodles, boil for 10–15 minutes depending on thickness, then turn off the heat, cover, and let sit for another 10–15 minutes. Strain and rinse very well to remove excess starch, then let dry for about 15 minutes before assembling.

For the Chicken:  -2 large chicken breasts, flattened  -Seasoning: 1 tbsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp Italian seasoning, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper, 1–2 tsp cayenne pepper (optional)  -1 tbsp olive oil For the Pasta & Sauce:  -8 oz (225 g) rigatoni  -3 tbsp butter  -1 large shallot, finely diced  -6–8 garlic cloves, minced  -1 cup heavy cream, room temperature  -Seasoning: 1 tsp chicken bouillon powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp Italian seasoning, 1 tsp black pepper  -3/4 cup freshly grated Parmesan (please use fresh!)  -1/2 cup pasta water, as needed (aka liquid gold) Instructions: 1. Pat the chicken dry & pound to an even thickness. Coat with 1 tbsp olive oil, then season on both sides. 2. Boil the pasta in salted water until just shy of al dente. This Banana Omelet Tastes Like French Toast 🍳 🍌 ⸻ Ingredients ▶️ 1 ripe banana (120 g) ▶️ 2 large eggs ▶️ 1/2 tsp ground cinnamon ▶️ 1/2 tsp vanilla powder ▶️ Small pinch of sea salt ▶️ 1 tsp butter or extra-virgin olive oil (for the pan) ⸻ Preparation 1. Peel the banana and mash it in a bowl until mostly smooth. 2. Add the eggs, cinnamon, vanilla powder, and sea salt. 3. Whisk until well combined. 4. Heat a non-stick skillet over medium-low heat and lightly grease it with the butter or olive oil. 5. Pour the mixture into the skillet and spread it into an even circle. 6. Cook for 3–4 minutes, until the bottom is golden and the top is mostly set. 7. Carefully flip the omelet with a wide spatula and cook for another 2–3 minutes, until fully cooked through. 8. Fold the omelet in half and serve warm. ⸻ Tips (For Best Results) 💡 Use a ripe banana: The riper the banana, the sweeter and more French toast-like the flavor. 💡 Cook over medium-low heat: This allows the eggs to cook through without burning the banana. 💡 Mash the banana well: A smoother mixture creates a more even texture. 💡 Use a non-stick skillet: It makes flipping much easier. 💡 Flip gently: Wait until the omelet is mostly set before turning it over. 💡 Customize the toppings: Serve with fresh berries, Greek yogurt, chopped nuts, or a drizzle of honey. 💡 Enjoy immediately: The texture is best while warm. ⸻ Nutrition (1 omelet) ✅ Calories: ~260 kcal ✅ Protein: ~14 g ✅ Carbs: ~25 g ✅ Fat: ~11 g ✅ Fiber: ~3 g #bananaomelet #healthybreakfast #highproteinbreakfast #healthyfood #recipe

Ingredients: 1 (25-ounce) package frozen cheese ravioli 3 1/2 cups store-bought Alfredo sauce 1 pound Italian sausage, cooked and crumbled 3 cups baby spinach 1/2 cup chopped marinated sundried tomatoes 2 cups shredded mozzarella cheese, divided 1/2 cup freshly grated Parmesan cheese, divided Directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (180 degrees C). Lightly grease a 3 quart baking dish with cooking spray. Spread about 1/2 cup sauce on the bottom of the dish and arrange half of the ravioli in a single layer over the sauce. Top with cooked sausage, spinach, and sundried tomatoes. Pour 1 1/2 cups of alfredo sauce over the spinach mixture. Cheesy Garlic Butter Shrimp Skewers 🍤🧄🧀 Recipe : These juicy shrimp skewers are covered in garlic butter and melted cheese, just like the video. Ingredients 1½ pounds jumbo shrimp, peeled and deveined, tails on 3 tablespoons melted butter 4 garlic cloves, minced 1 tablespoon olive oil 1 teaspoon Italian seasoning ½ teaspoon paprika ½ teaspoon onion powder ½ teaspoon salt ¼ teaspoon black pepper 1 tablespoon lemon juice 1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese ¼ cup freshly grated Parmesan cheese 2 tablespoons chopped parsley Wooden or metal skewers Instructions If using wooden skewers, soak them in water for at least 20 minutes. Pat the shrimp completely dry. Thread 4–5 shrimp tightly onto each skewer. Mix the melted butter, garlic, olive oil, Italian seasoning, paprika, onion powder, salt, pepper and lemon juice. Brush the garlic-butter mixture generously over both sides of the shrimp. Place the skewers on a lined baking sheet and bake at 425°F for 6 minutes. Remove them from the oven and sprinkle generously with mozzarella and Parmesan. Return to the oven for another 3–5 minutes, until the shrimp are pink and the cheese is melted. Broil for 1–2 minutes to create the golden-brown top shown in the video. Drizzle with the remaining garlic butter and finish with fresh parsley and a squeeze of lemon. Important: Shrimp cook quickly. Remove them as soon as they are opaque and reach 145°F internally so they stay juicy. Serve with garlic bread, pasta, rice or roasted vegetables.  #GarlicButterShrimp #ShrimpSkewers #SeafoodRecipe #EasyDinnerIdeas #FoodTokRecipes
